title: Distributed Sketching on Data Partitions for OLS Regression
abstract: arXiv:2607.07888v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies a scalable approach for ordinary least squares (OLS) regression based on distributed sketching. It distributes small sketches of a large data set across multiple workers, has each worker construct a local OLS estimator from its sketch, and averages the local estimators into a global one. Prior studies assume each sketch is generated from all data, but this sketching step has high computation cost, sometimes even higher than standard OLS. Instead, we propose to generate each sketch from a partitioned subset of the data, which allows the sketching cost to decrease with more workers. Under the fixed design setting, we characterize the exact excess loss of the global estimator. This loss is higher than the loss established in prior studies, but remains close to it when the average Burg divergence between subset covariances is small. translated_title: 面向普通最小二乘（OLS）回归的数据分区分布式草图方法
translated_abstract: 本文研究了一种基于分布式草图的可扩展普通最小二乘（OLS）回归方法。该方法将大型数据集的小型草图分发到多个工作节点，让每个工作节点根据其草图构建局部OLS估计器，再将各局部估计器平均为全局估计器。以往的研究假设每个草图都是从全部数据生成的，但这一草图生成步骤计算成本很高，有时甚至高于标准OLS。相反，我们提出从数据的分区子集中生成每个草图，从而使草图生成成本随工作节点数量的增加而降低。在固定设计设置下，我们刻画了全局估计器的精确超额损失。该损失高于以往研究所建立的损失，但当子集协方差之间的平均Burg散度较小时，它仍与后者保持接近。由于在我们的分区设计下，工作节点数量的增加往往会增大该散度，此……
tldr: 本文提出从数据分区子集生成草图的新型分布式OLS回归方法，使草图计算成本随工作节点增多而下降，并刻画了全局估计器的精确超额损失，证明当子集协方差间平均Burg散度较小时，其性能接近基于全数据草图的方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a distributed sketching approach for OLS regression that generates sketches from data partitions, reducing sketching cost as workers increase, and characterizes the exact excess loss of the global estimator, which remains close to prior bounds when the average Burg divergence between subset covariances is small.
